_keys.note: Day 1, 9:00 lecture slice. Written by Content Writer. Same voice as day1_morning.json. Westville Campus only, no real institution branding. Every line is kept under about 90 characters for phone screens.
_keys.who: Who speaks: player, zanele, lecturer, student, auntie, narrator.
_keys.caption: Narration line shown while something moves on screen.
_keys.move: The on-screen motion cue for that tap, so no tap is only a bar and numbers.
_keys.variants: on_time and late versions of the same beat. Pick by whether the player arrived by 09:00.
_keys.seats: Three seat choices. 'deltas' are small extras on top of the normal lecture_attend gain (grades +8, energy -10). Scale matches activities.csv.
_keys.moments: Pick one moment per lecture at random. Each has two choices. Each choice has outcomes with a tone (good, neutral, bad), a weight (chance), the result line and the stat deltas. Weights in a choice add up to 1.
_keys.deltas: Stat changes on the existing scale: money, energy, hunger (Fullness), grades, social.

goal.text: Find a seat and get through the lecture.
goal.hint: Pick your spot, then see what the morning throws at you.
goal.done: Lecture done. Not bad for day one.

arrive_venue.caption: Business Hall. A sign, a heavy door, and the smell of old chalk.
arrive_venue.bell: The bell rings. Everyone suddenly walks faster.

lecturer_line.text: Doors close at nine. Not five past, nine.

arrive_venue.move: Students stream toward the door, bag straps swing, a bell rings from the courtyard.

on_time.caption: Packed, but not full. Voices bounce off the high ceiling.
on_time.move: Door swings open, camera glides over rows of heads, hands wave you toward a gap.

student_line.text: Is this the right venue? Please say yes.

late.caption: The room goes quiet. Every head turns, slowly.
late.move: Door creaks, one chair scrapes, a hundred eyes swing toward you.

lecturer_line.text: Ah. Our guest of honour. Please, sit.

late.note: Late: front rows are full. The front seat is not offered, or is marked taken.

find_seat.caption: Rows of fold-down seats, a few gaps, one wave from across the room.

options.label: Front row
options.line: Front row. Nobody is brave enough to sit near the lecturer's gaze.

zanele.text: Front row? You are insane. I respect it.

options.label: Back corner
options.line: Back corner. Good view of everyone else's mistakes.

zanele.text: Back corner. A classic. I will visit.

options.label: Next to Zanele
options.line: Zanele pats the seat beside her like she owns it. She might.

zanele.text: I saved you a seat. And one biscuit. Do not tell.

zanele_lines.text: Sit, sit. We only have forty minutes of shame left.
You were so slow. I almost told them you moved to Joburg.
Did you see that? Tell me you saw that.
You are a genius. I will say it exactly once.
Fine. We live to fight another lecture.
Ooh. That was bold. Slightly stupid, but bold.
Tuck shop? I owe you noodles. And you owe me a story.
Text me from the back. I want a full report.

moments.title: Cold call
moments.caption: The lecturer scans the room and stops. Right on you.

line.text: You. Name one reason to study this subject.

moments.move: Lecturer points, the room turns, a chair creaks, your pulse shows as a tiny thump.

outcomes.text: You say something clever. The lecturer nods once. That is a standing ovation.
You say something vague with great confidence. It works, mostly.
You say "vibes". The room laughs. The lecturer does not.
"Honest." The lecturer asks someone else. You live.
You shrug. The lecturer moves on, but you feel the look.

moments.title: Projector dies
moments.caption: A click, a hum, a long sigh. Load shedding catches the whole room.

line.text: Stage four. We continue on the board. Pens out.

moments.move: Lights flicker and drop, the projector fan winds down, phone torches pop up.

choices.label: Copy every word off the board

outcomes.text: Your hand cramps. You have the best notes in the room.
You miss a few lines, but the gist survives the dark.
Someone tells a story. You laugh until your cheeks hurt.
You miss the one thing the lecturer says will be on the test.

moments.title: Someone is sleeping
moments.caption: Two rows ahead, a head is slowly sliding off a desk.

line.text: The snoring is soft. The lecturer has not noticed. Yet.

moments.move: Student's head tilts, drool shine, a pen rolls off the desk and clatters.

outcomes.text: They jerk up, whisper thanks, and offer you a sweet.
They grunt, go back to sleep, and you feel mildly useless.
The lecturer's glare lands on the wrong person. Not you.
The lecturer catches it, and the snore turns into a speech.

moments.title: A stranger needs a pen
moments.caption: Someone leans over and whispers. "Please. Mine died."

line.text: Please. I will give it back. Probably.

moments.move: A hand reaches over, you hold out your only pen, a small grateful smile.

outcomes.text: They return it with a snack. A tiny friendship begins.
They give it back at the end. Chewed, but returned.
You never see the pen again. Gone with the stranger.
They find another one. The room moves on.
They sigh loudly. Three rows hear it.

moments.title: The attendance register
moments.caption: A clipboard drifts down the row, hand to hand.

line.text: Sign your own name. Yes, I will check.

moments.move: Clipboard passes from hand to hand, a pen swings from a string, a row of heads leans in.

outcomes.text: A neat signature. The lecturer ticks you and moves on.
Your pen skips, so you sign twice. Close enough.
Nobody checks. Your friend owes you a bunny chow.
The lecturer spots the handwriting. A warning, in writing.

end_of_lecture.caption: Chairs scrape. A hundred people breathe out at once.
end_of_lecture.bell: The bell rings. Notes get stuffed into bags. Someone claps. Nobody knows why.

lecturer_line.text: Read chapter one. Yes, all of it.

end_of_lecture.move: Students stand, bags zip, the door opens and sunlight crosses the floor.

summary.grades_note: Attended lecture, the normal +8 grades applies.
summary.line: Day one, lecture one. You have survived. Probably learned something.

tap_feedback: A pen clicks two rows away.
A chair squeaks like a small protest.
Chalk dust drifts in the light.
